segments.name: Bioproduction products and services
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and markets biopreservation media and cell processing products that improve quality and de-risk biologic manufacturing for cell and gene therapy customers.
segments.evidence: We currently operate as one bioproduction products and services business which supports several steps in the biologic material manufacturing and delivery process.

revenueModel.text: Customers, primarily cell and gene therapy developers, pay the company for sales of biopreservation media and cell processing tools, with revenue recognized upon shipment.
revenueModel.evidence: Product revenues are generated from the sale of biopreservation media and cell processing tools.

changes.evidence: SAVSU contained our evo cloud connected "smart" shipping container products that provided passive storage and transport for temperature-sensitive biologics and pharmaceuticals.
